name: ProgressBar
summary: A thin horizontal bar showing how much of a task is done (determinate) or that work is under way with no known end (indeterminate). Choose it over a spinner when the task has measurable progress or runs long enough to warrant a bar in the layout.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Progress from 0 to max. Omitted, the bar is indeterminate.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: The value at which the bar is full.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Corner treatment of track and bar.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The bar's colour; applies only to a determinate bar.

inputs.name: indeterminateMotion
inputs.description: The indeterminate animation; pass null to disable it.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: The root: a full-width block in colorNeutralBackground6 that clips the bar.

anatomy.name: Bar
anatomy.description: The filled portion, full height, inheriting the track's radius; its width is the value's percentage, or a moving 33% segment when indeterminate.

variants.description: Track and bar round by borderRadiusMedium.
Bar colorCompoundBrandBackground; also the only colour of an indeterminate bar.

layout.text: The track is a block, 100% of its container's width, colorNeutralBackground6, clipping its content; 2px tall at medium, 4px at large.
The bar is full height with the track's radius. Determinate, its width is value ÷ max as a percentage, clamped to 0–100%.

Indeterminate, the bar is at most 33% of the track and fills with a horizontal gradient colorNeutralBackground6 → colorTransparentBackground → colorNeutralBackground6 over the brand colour, so the segment fades in and out at its ends. Under reduced motion it is full width instead.

states.text: Determinate: the bar in its colour (brand by default) from the start of the track to the value.

states.label: indeterminate
states.text: No value: a 33% faded brand segment that moves across the track; the color prop is ignored.
None: the progress bar is not focusable and draws no focus indicator.

behaviour.text: A determinate bar above 1% of the way animates width changes over 300ms with the CSS ease curve; at or below that threshold it jumps, so a reset to 0 is not animated.
The indeterminate segment's travel is supplied by the indeterminateMotion slot, not the styles file; under reduced motion the segment is full width and that motion pulses its opacity instead.
The color prop applies only when a value is given; an indeterminate bar is always brand.

semantics: aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax max and aria-valuenow value when determinate; no aria-valuenow when indeterminate
label it through a Field label or aria-label; a Field's validation message can describe an error bar

notes.text: Thicknesses (2, 4px), the 33% indeterminate width and the 300ms ease width transition are constants in the styles file; the transition reads no duration or curve token.

The status colours read palette tokens, not the status aliases: error is colorPaletteRedBackground3 (not the cranberry-mapped danger family) and warning colorPaletteDarkOrangeBackground3 (not the orange-mapped warning family).
Under forced colours the track is CanvasText and the bar Highlight, whatever its colour.
Pair the bar with a label above and a description below (Field) when the task needs explaining; the component itself has no text slot.
